purpose: Consumer settings and physical conditions for the complete nominal two-port model; qualification is established separately by retained results

network.port_1: P1 signal p relative to finite-frame contact P4
network.port_2: P2 signal n relative to the same finite-frame contact P4
network.terminal_planes: Outer ends of the two 5 um feeds; preserve the complete finite Metal1 frame and modeled environment
network.calibration: Uncalibrated point/internal ports; no de-embedding or lead removal

interpolation.method: Piecewise linear interpolation of every complex S entry in real/imaginary coordinates
interpolation.default_warning: ADS Data Based interpolation uses polar coordinates for S parameters; an RI Touchstone header alone does not select rectangular interpolation
interpolation.extrapolation: Not permitted outside the separately qualified frequency domain; native constant-extrapolation capability is not authorization to extrapolate

low_frequency_extension.zero_hz: Optional derived floating series-resistance network; never an actual EM sample
low_frequency_extension.prerequisites: Independent DC/contact review, actual LF mesh/contact/return evidence and explicit DC/LF agreement
low_frequency_extension.between_DC_and_first_actual_RF: A separately declared derived complex-RI linear segment, with its mathematical properties and physical support reported separately
low_frequency_extension.inductance_at_zero_hz: Undefined by Im(Zd)/(2*pi*f); a derived positive-frequency limit is not an actual DC inductance solve

validity.materials: Explicit assumed research stack with constant coefficients; no foundry or InP qualification
validity.additional_pads_routing_shields_or_nearb: Require a new environment assessment and appropriate EM verification
validity.frequency_domain: Read the final qualification report and model receipt; neither the 200 GHz search endpoint nor the material-assumption range establishes qualification
validity.time_domain_or_causality: Not established by pointwise passivity or this interpolation contract
